questions.question: Which is the most natural English translation of today's [ZH] line: "看看他实现的怎么样, 然后,还留了这些问题看怎么处理"?
options: A. Take a look at how he implemented it, then figure out how to handle the remaining issues.
B. See his implement how, then leave these problems look how to process.
C. Look at how he did the implementation, then see these left problems how to deal.
D. Check his implementation situation, after that watch these problems how handle.
questions.explanation: 看看…怎么样 means review or assess how something was done. 还留了这些问题 means the remaining/open issues left in the work — option A captures both the review and follow-up planning.

questions.question: Which correction fixes the grammar in today's [EN] line: "So tts should deployed on the 3576"?
options: A. So TTS should be deployed on the 3576.
B. So TTS should deploy on the 3576.
C. So TTS should deploying on the 3576.
D. So TTS should to deploy on the 3576.
questions.explanation: After modal verbs like should, use the base verb. Passive voice needs be + past participle: should be deployed.

questions.question: Which question best corrects today's [EN] line: "what the current status of this project?"
options: A. What is the current status of this project?
B. What the current status is of this project?
C. What current status of this project?
D. What are the current status of this project?
questions.explanation: A wh-question needs an auxiliary verb: What is the current status… Status is singular, so use is, not are.

questions.question: In today's [EN] entry you wrote "hold off for now, just keep TTS on the 1828." What does "hold off" mean here?
options: A. Delay or postpone the planned action for now.
B. Physically hold the device in place.
C. Stop the TTS service permanently.
D. Increase the priority of deployment.
questions.explanation: Hold off means wait or postpone — you decided not to move TTS to the 3576 yet and keep it on the 1828 board.

questions.question: Which spelling fix is correct for today's [EN] question about rknn_model_zoo: "Does it run on CPU or NPU after convertion?"
options: A. Does it run on CPU or NPU after conversion?
B. Does it run on CPU or NPU after convertation?
C. Does it run on CPU or NPU after converting?
D. Does it seems run on CPU or NPU after convertion?
questions.explanation: The noun form is conversion (from convert), not convertion. After conversion asks about runtime behavior once models are converted to RKNN format.

questions.question: Which English question best translates today's [ZH] line: "瑞芯微的板子上有Android系统吧"?
options: A. Rockchip boards run Android, right?
B. Rockchip board have Android system on it, yes?
C. On Rockchip's board there is Android system, isn't it?
D. The Rockchip plate has Android OS installed, correct?
questions.explanation: 瑞芯微 is Rockchip. 吧 at the end seeks confirmation — run Android, right? is natural for asking whether the boards ship with Android.

questions.question: Translate into natural English: "瑞芯微的板子上有Android系统吧"
questions.explanation: 瑞芯微 (Rockchip) boards commonly ship with Android. The particle 吧 turns the statement into a confirmation question.

questions.question: Rewrite today's [EN] line as a clear deployment question: "I just want to clarify: is it running on the 1828?"
questions.modelAnswer: I just want to clarify: is it running on the 1828?
questions.explanation: Your original phrasing is already natural. Clarify signals you want a precise yes/no answer about which board the service is active on.

questions.question: Fix the grammar in today's [EN] instruction: "let test"
questions.explanation: Let test is incomplete. Let's (let us) test is the standard short instruction to run a test or try something.

questions.question: Write a natural English sentence expressing today's deployment decision: because of the 1828's memory limit, deploy everything else on the 3576 except the LLM.
questions.modelAnswer: Because of the 1828's memory limit, we should deploy everything else on the 3576, except the LLM.
questions.explanation: Because of introduces a constraint. Everything else on the 3576, except the LLM keeps the LLM on the 1828 while offloading other workloads to the more capable board.
